learning.initial: Draft a single-paragraph internal decision memo: the ceramics studio will rent kiln K for six months because it has spare capacity; reassess if monthly demand exceeds 80 pieces. Reply here.
learning.correction: The paragraph buries the decision and the condition for changing it. For my internal decision memos, I want exactly three level-two headings in this order: Decision, Basis, Revisit. Put the chosen action, its supplied reason, and the stated review condition under them. Do not invent a review date. Please rewrite it that way and use this structure for my later decision memos.

exam: Draft an internal decision memo for our seed library: choose a paper sign-out ledger for the winter pilot because internet access in the shed is unreliable; review the choice if weekly loans exceed 45. Reply here.

behavior.principle: Use exactly the three Markdown level-two headings Decision, Basis, Revisit, in order, without any other headings.
behavior.positive:
## Decision
Use the paper ledger.
## Basis
The supplied reason.
## Revisit
The supplied threshold.
behavior.negative: One paragraph or headings Recommendation/Background/Next steps, even if substantively correct.

quality: Choose a paper ledger for the winter pilot; give unreliable shed internet as reason and more than 45 weekly loans as the review trigger. No invented dates, outcomes or facts.
